rv.q: But this is a tale of the heart with life-and-death stakes, born of agonizing error and lifelong regret.
Edward Hall’s Winter’s Tale insists upon the invigorating bonds of community and the (at times literally) transformational power of love.

cn.t: Chicago Shakespeare Theater's The Winter's Tale earns strong praise for its emotional, uplifting production. Critics highlight its resonant storytelling and ambitious staging as standout strengths.
